headline: The r20 spectral-window theorem admits a parameter form. In particular rank 1_{|A|>=1/81}=3 is enough: either the surviving high-window Gram after removing leverage>1/32 rows has floor >=1/2 and the output has continuous C_0 density with sup<100, or a unit high-spectral direction has >1/2 mass on <=95 physical coordinates.
first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-SPECTRAL81-LOCALIZED-HYBRID-v1: pay the bounded-cardinality localized branch while retaining the dense spectral tail and remaining spread high directions.
